overview: Chaleydonia is a crystal capital on Christophsis, documented across Clone Wars. Chaleydonia's crystal spires saw the Clone Wars' first pitched battles between Republic and Separatist armies.
history:

Films, Clone Wars, Rebels, Mandalorian, Ahsoka, KOTOR, KOTOR II, TOR, and Sith Empire narratives all treat Chaleydonia as more than scenery—it is a decision point.

Ancient and pre-Republic layers beneath Chaleydonia include buried fortresses, Rakatan relics, and Sith ward-stones that still disrupt modern sensors. Chaleydonia has been invaded, liberated, blockaded, and rebuilt more times than most planetary capitals, making its streets a palimpsest of battle damage. Battle dossiers from multiple eras mark Chaleydonia as contested territory on Christophsis. Chaleydonia runs on local industry, trade tariffs, and black-market mediation typical of Christophsis. Cultural life in Chaleydonia mixes planetary tradition with imported habits from every species that ever missed a connection and stayed. Chaleydonia influences galactic history disproportionately because leaders, smugglers, and prophets treat it as neutral ground until it suddenly is not.
